visual_action: A montage of video clips that have been digitally altered to show the musician Nicki Minaj standing next to Donald Trump at a political-style event. The clips alternate between shots of Minaj smiling and making a peace sign, Trump speaking and making animated facial expressions, and close-ups of Minaj's hand with long fingernails seemingly holding Trump's hand. A sparkling light effect is overlaid on some of the clips.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown speaking at a podium throughout the video.

cast.name: Nicki Minaj
cast.evidence: She is digitally inserted into the video next to Donald Trump and is the subject of the fabricated interaction.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats account.

spoken_summary: The audio is a mix of Nicki Minaj's song "Your Love" and soundbites of Donald Trump's voice making exclamations like "Ah!" and "Yeah!" The audible lyrics include "Shawty, I'm only...".
audio_music: The video features the upbeat pop/R&B song "Your Love" by Nicki Minaj, used sarcastically to create a romantic theme for the fabricated pairing. This is intercut with audio clips of Donald Trump's voice from a rally, creating a jarring, mocking effect.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between shots of Trump, the superimposed clips of Nicki Minaj, and close-ups of their digitally combined hands. The editing also uses overlay effects like sparkles.
manipulation_or_satire: The musician Nicki Minaj is digitally superimposed into video clips of Donald Trump at an event. Scenes showing them standing together and holding hands are fabricated to create the false appearance of a close, romantic relationship for satirical and mocking purposes.
cultural_references: The song 'Your Love' by Nicki Minaj
central_claim: The video falsely and sarcastically presents a romantic relationship between Donald Trump and Nicki Minaj to mock Trump.
intended_effect: To cause the viewer to laugh at, ridicule, and feel disgust towards Donald Trump by placing him in an absurd, fabricated scenario.
